name: Absolution
passiveDesc: CRIT DMG increased by 20%/25%/30%/35%/40%. Increasing the value of a Bond of Life increases the DMG the equipping character deals by 16%/20%/24%/28%/32% for 6s. Max 3 stacks.
description: A rapier once wielded by a deceiver who had forsaken everything. In the past, it was primarily used as a tool when he had to disguise his identity.
